purpose: Fail-closed activation-time handoff template for reconciling exact accepted T10/T11 public IDs against the exact post-T11 integration head. The preparation template stays blank even when an individual dependency such as T10 is already approved.

resolved_public_id_shape.kind: semantic kind such as transform_state, transform_recipe, camp_state, camp_recipe_binding
resolved_public_id_shape.source_path: repository-relative JSON source containing the identifier
resolved_public_id_shape.json_pointer: RFC6901-style pointer resolving to the exact identifier value

rules: Do not populate this preparation template. At activation, copy it to BINDING_RESOLUTION.json and populate each dependency only from its accepted integrated completion record.
Every resolved ID must be proven by an ownership-safe repository source_path plus exact JSON pointer, byte-identical to the accepted dependency commit; prose-only evidence is insufficient.
No provisional/prepared/example/debug/test-only identifier may be promoted as a shipping progression binding.
Resolution is read-only proof. T12 may consume accepted IDs but may not mutate T10/T11 source files or semantics.
Any missing or ambiguous required ID blocks T12 activation rather than being guessed.
